sentences: rs12913832 is an intron variant in HERC2 (NM_004667.6:c.13272+874T>C) that has been shown to determine human blue‑brown eye color and modulate pigmentation. [F2, F7].
In the gnomAD v4 genomes dataset the alternate G allele (A>G) is present on 49% of alleles (74054/152216) with an allele frequency of 0.486506. [F4].
The G‑allele frequency varies by ancestry, reaching a maximum of 89% (9400/10616) in Finnish Europeans and a minimum of 0.17% (9/5182) in East Asians. [F5].
ClinVar classifies the variant as an association with skin, hair and eye pigmentation, specifically blue versus non‑blue eyes, though no assertion criteria are provided. [F6].
